activity_summary: You paid twelve pence at the tiltyard gate and went in among the citizens, far down the barrier. The yeomen kept the crowd with staves held crosswise. You did not come for a face you could name.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid, and did not ask for a better place.

facets.activity: Paid twelve pence and went in behind the barrier

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Twelve pence. I am not come for a face.
